title: Conquest of SkyrimNet
tagline: Choose a government, raise an army, conquer territory and manage your economy with the end goal being to become the High King of Skyrim
description: # Conquest of SkyrimNet Conquest of SkyrimNet is an ambitious mod that allows the player to create their own faction independent of the Stormcloaks and the Empire. The player can choose a government, raise an army, conquer territory and manage their economy with the end goal being to become the High King of Skyrim. DON'T START THIS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE CIVIL WAR Found your own faction in Skyrim, rule its holds, lead its armies and run its treasury, mostly by **talking to people**. Conquest of SkyrimNet builds on Conquest of Skyrim and adds a government you speak to through SkyrimNet, along with a PrismaUI faction screen, requests from your people, unrest and uprisings, army morale, deserters, bribery and coups, and settlements you build yourself. THIS WAS MADE USING THE ORIGINAL CODE OF CONQUEST OF SKYRIM, AUTHORED BY **GALVATRON530**. > **New here?** Skip down to What to say, and to whom. You don't need exact > wording: say what you mean in your own words. The NPC decides whether to act, and anything that costs gold or > can't be undone asks you to confirm first. --- ## Requirements | Required | Link | |---|---| | Skyrim SE/AE with SKSE64 | skse. | | PapyrusUtil | Nexus Mods | | SkyUI + MCM Helper | SkyUI · MCM Helper | | **PrismaUI**: the faction screen | Nexus Mods | | **SkyrimNet**: Conversation, knowledge and memories | Nexus Mods | | Optional / recommended | Link | What it adds | |---|---|---| | **Physical Letters** | GitHub | Requests reach you as letters by courier. | | **SeverActions** (recommended) | GitHub | More SkyrimNet actions, so NPCs can follow you, travel, craft, change outfits, make arrests and fight. It pairs well with the faction's officers and soldiers. | Conquest of SkyrimNet **replaces** Conquest of Skyrim (`conquerskyrim.esp`), so remove that first. ## Install 1. Install `ConquestOfSkyrimNet_v.zip` with your mod manager and enable `ConquestOfSkyrimNet.esp`. 2. In the installer, keep **SkyrimNet knowledge** ticked if you use SkyrimNet. 3. Start a new game, or continue a save made with an earlier version of Conquest of SkyrimNet. 4. Read the **Start my Faction** book to pick your faction's name, army prefix and banner. 5. Go to MCM > Conquest of SkyrimNet > General and bind **Faction menu**. It's unbound by default. ## Your first hour 1. **Found your faction** with the book. 2. **Take a claim.** Clear a bandit camp, a mine or a fort and plant your banner (see Taking claims). 3. **Appoint a Steward.** Ask a friendly NPC: *"I need someone to run my treasury. Will you be my Steward?"* 4. **Appoint a General**, and a **Captain** for your first army. 5. **Open the faction screen** with your hotkey. It shows your treasury, supplies, lands, armies and requests. 6. From then on, run the realm by talking to the people who serve you. ## Credits Built on **Conquest of Skyrim**. Conversation through SkyrimNet. Menus by PrismaUI. Letters by Physical Letters. Recommended companion: SeverActions.
